title: Claude (agent session)
description: The LLM agent that works in this repository's sessions, under the name it writes into workflow history (`actor: "claude"` in `beans/workflows/*.json`). Declared so the PROV-O QA/QC report can resolve that name to an actor (owner, 2026-09-24: "Declare both"). The id is the name the agent asserts, not a login: history records it as `asserted` and nothing here authenticates it, and which session or account it was is the data store's to know. `roles` are the lanes its history entries occupy and whose role admits an agent: `authoring-agent` (every code-change-review step it recorded, and the CRDM agent steps) `code-reviewer` (`Task_Review` in code-change-review) and `business-analyst` (below). It also recorded one `BA_Submit` in the `business-analyst` lane, and the owner ruled on 2026-09-24 (*"Allow agents as BA"*) that the role admits agents, so it is listed. What it may DO is in the ODRL policies, and none grants it anything yet.
